column1: # Kotlin fact counters (.kt, .kts), for a rule with the shared prompt file-body-oop: one per line,
# label TAB pattern (Java regex), counted over the whole file. The [ignore] line runs first and reads
# the file as the Kotlin lexer does, leftmost region first: it blanks line comments, block comments
# (nested, as Kotlin nests them), raw strings ("""...""") and string and character literals with their
# ${...} templates, so a "fun" or "class" in a KDoc, a string or a commented-out block does not count.
# A region that is never closed runs to the end of the file. "functions (approx)" counts every fun
# declared at the start of a line (members, top-level, local and extension functions), not a fun
# interface; "constructor properties" every val or var after "(" or ",", which is a primary
# constructor's property and, rarely, a lambda's destructuring, but not the subject of a
# when (val y = ...). Counts are regex heuristics: a
# declaration that starts after another on the same line, or a string template nested more than one
# level, is not read as the compiler reads it. JvmFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
